results.description:
I accidentally hooked up with a hitman…

Candy

I've got the shittiest taste in men.

Seriously.

I'm a witness to a murder thanks to my ex.

And I manage to do it again.

At my boss's wedding, I hook up with the hottest guy ever.

Older.

Tattooed.

Sexy.

Wreaking of panty-melting danger.

Best night of my life.

It's not until the next morning, I find out…

He's the most lethal killer the Russian Mafia has ever produced.

And now, he's decided he'd like some more Candy.

It gets worse.

He wasn't even a guest.

He's at war with my boss, the only person who's helped me in years.

That's right. I slept with my boss's enemy.

And now, I'm dead center in their battle to dominate New York's underworld.

If my ex-boyfriend doesn't get me, if being trapped in a vicious mafia war doesn't do it, then…

My taste in men—it's going to kill me.
